hooks.command: osascript -e 'display notification "Session about to compact — un-persisted state will be lossy" with title "Claude auto-compact"' 2>/dev/null || echo '[PreCompact] Session about to compact; un-persisted state will be lossy. Write it to disk first. / 会话即将压缩，未落盘状态将有损——先落盘再说' >&2

s="${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT:-}/scripts/ctx-watermark.py"; [ -f "$s" ] || s="$HOME/.claude/scripts/ctx-watermark.py"; [ -f "$s" ] || exit 0; for c in ${CTXKIT_PYTHON:-} python3 /usr/local/bin/python3 /opt/homebrew/bin/python3; do if command -v "$c" >/dev/null 2>&1 && "$c" -c 'import json' >/dev/null 2>&1; then "$c" "$s"; break; fi; done; exit 0
